name: Aurora Anguilla Resort & Golf Club
insider_take: This pristine Caribbean gem sits on 300 acres of untouched coastline where luxury meets authentic island charm, offering an exclusive escape on one of the Caribbean's most coveted private islands.
whats_special: Aurora Anguilla boasts the island's only championship 18-hole golf course designed by Greg Norman, plus access to four stunning beaches including the famous Rendezvous Bay. The resort features a world-class spa and some of the Caribbean's most sophisticated dining, all while maintaining Anguilla's legendary laid-back vibe.
pro_tip: Book tee times early for the Greg Norman golf course - the oceanfront holes offer breathtaking views, and the course is considered one of the Caribbean's most challenging and scenic layouts.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary shuttle to nearby Shoal Bay East, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches, and time your visit for sunset at the resort's signature restaurant overlooking the pristine coastline - the views are absolutely magical.
pros: Championship golf course with stunning Caribbean views
Pristine beachfront location on exclusive Anguilla
cons: Remote island location requires connecting flights
